_comment: v11 BUG-FIX RETRAIN (2026-05-06): same feature set and model architecture as deployed v11; retraining purely to absorb code-level fixes. Bugs fixed: (1) airports.csv timezones for ECP/VPS/PNS (FL Panhandle Eastern->Central) and AZA/FLG/PRC/YUM (AZ regional Denver->Phoenix), correcting `dep_dt_local` UTC instants and hourly weather joins for these airports; (2) flightnum_od_otp_rate_last14d aggregation (training was mean-of-daily-rates, now per-flight to match serving's calculation); (3) flightnum_od_support_count_last14d 2x double-count in the deployed parquet (training code already fixed 2026-04-25; retrain absorbs the fix into the bundle). Date range narrowed to 2023-01-01..2025-12-31 (3 years). Bundle joblib filename unchanged so S3 upload overwrites the deployed v11 bundles. See exploration/v11_bugfix_retrain_plan.md.

_workflow.prerequisite: Complete both steps of blueprint_dep_WN_v11_retrain.json first.

_path_note: All data paths use '../flightrightdata/data/...' (REPO_ROOT-relative) because features_arr.py resolves all paths against REPO_ROOT.
